name: Lunar-Charged
description:
Creates a [Thundercloud] that deals 2 Electro DMG at the end of the Round. (Usage: 1. Can stack, no stack limit.)
When the [Thundercloud] is created or when its usages increase, apply [Electric Shock] to a random card in your opponent's Hand.
